name: SCALP_SCORE_NETWORK_DEADLINE_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: SCALP_SCORE_NETWORK_DEADLINE_20261107 — the 5-min scalp lane's score phase gets a wall-clock cap.
2026-11-06 forensics: 64 of 78 cycles were SIGTERMed by `timeout 295` inside `score` (one more in `ingest`),
because the phase was the only one with no cap and every ticker took a yfinance .actions (reverse split),
a .info (industry/sector/company name), up to two .history calls and, for an unverified headline, an
unbounded Yahoo RSS fetch — all serial. scoring.score_network_deadline() now bounds them by the cycle
deadline, the lane's score_network_budget_s and a 30 s tail kept for halt detection, persist and the alert;
past the window a row still scores on the data already held and the receipt records
scoring_network_skips + budget_skips ['scoring_network'] — a cut cycle never looks like a cold universe.
Callers that pass no deadline (the full run) keep the previous behaviour. Hermetic: fakes only, no network,
